info.description: Peer-assisted video delivery. Generated from contracts/api.json; do not edit by hand. Run `npm run docs:generate`.

apiKey.description: The raw secret (`key_…`). Returned once and never stored in plain text.

offloadCap.description: Maximum share of traffic peers may serve. Null means uncapped.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser origins allowed to use the public token. Empty means any origin.

meteredDefault.description: Prefer the CDN on connections the browser reports as metered.

code.description: Machine-readable code. See contracts/errors.json for the catalog.

stripe.description: Best-effort Stripe mirror. `connected:false` when the key is unset.

cdnBytes.description: Bytes served by the origin/CDN path.

p2pBytes.description: Bytes served by peers and accepted after verification.

savingsUsd.description: Offloaded bytes priced at the captured CDN rate. Present on metering responses.

feeUsd.description: Seedess savings-share fee. Present on metering responses.

keepUsd.description: Savings left with the customer after the fee. Present on metering responses.

id.description: Organisation id (`ten_…`). Also the tenant id.

role.description: The caller's role in this organisation, on list responses.

myRole.description: The caller's role, on single-organisation responses.

master.description: Rewritten HLS master playlist with `h`/`size` on every segment. Null for DASH.

manifest.description: Rewritten DASH MPD. Null for HLS.

playlist.description: Single-variant media playlist, when the source has no master.

signaling.description: WebSocket room URL. Exchange the path's `https:` for `wss:`.

p2p.description: False when the stream's kill switch is on. The client must then stay on the CDN.

master.description: True when the source was a multi-variant master.

publicToken.description: Read-only browser token (`pk_…`). Safe to put in page source.

url.description: The origin HLS master or media playlist URL. http(s) only; private addresses are refused.

id.description: Stable id, also the signaling room. Omit to generate `str_…`.

live.description: Treat the source as a live window.

variantId.description: Manifest index (`v0`, `v1`) or `audio_0` / `sub_0` for auxiliary tracks.

id.description: Stream id, also the signaling room name.

killSwitch.description: When true the CDN carries every byte.

snippet.description: Copy-paste hls.js integration. Null when there is no shipped SDK for the format.

sessionId.description: Random id generated once per playback session. The server counts a session on first sight.

apiKey.description: Control-plane API key (`key_…`). Server-side only; never ship it in a browser.

sessionCookie.name: seedess_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly dashboard session cookie, set by sign-in or OAuth.

streamToken.name: token
streamToken.description: Per-stream public token (`pk_…`). Read-only; safe in page source.

x-error-catalog.BAD_REQUEST: The request body or parameters are missing or malformed.
x-error-catalog.UNAUTHORIZED: No valid credential was supplied, or it is no longer valid.
x-error-catalog.FORBIDDEN: The credential is valid but the account or role is not allowed to do this.
x-error-catalog.NOT_FOUND: The resource does not exist, or the caller cannot see it.
x-error-catalog.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The route exists but does not accept this HTTP method.
x-error-catalog.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests from this address. Retry after the Retry-After header.
x-error-catalog.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The tenant has reached its stream limit.
x-error-catalog.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: A telemetry batch exceeded 16 KiB and was rejected.
x-error-catalog.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
x-error-catalog.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with that email already exists.
x-error-catalog.EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Verify the account email before creating or changing resources.
x-error-catalog.INVALID_TOKEN: The verification or reset token is invalid or expired.
x-error-catalog.INVITE_INVALID: The organisation invite is invalid, expired, or for another address.
x-error-catalog.ALREADY_MEMBER: That address already belongs to the organisation.
x-error-catalog.LAST_OWNER: An organisation must keep at least one owner.
x-error-catalog.INGEST_FAILED: Seedess could not fetch or parse the manifest.
x-error-catalog.REFRESH_FAILED: Seedess could not refresh the live manifest.
x-error-catalog.DEMO_NOT_READY: The public demo source is not configured on this Worker.
x-error-catalog.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: The request Origin is not on the stream's allow-list.
x-error-catalog.P2P_DISABLED: Peer delivery is disabled for this stream by its kill switch.
x-error-catalog.NOT_READY: The playlist or segments are not available yet.
x-error-catalog.EGRESS_RATE_MISSING: Set the CDN egress rate before generating an invoice.
x-error-catalog.MINUTES_NOT_TRACKED: Per-minute billing needs peer-served minutes, which are not tracked yet.
x-error-catalog.DISPUTE_CLOSED: This invoice dispute is already resolved.
x-error-catalog.NO_DISPUTE: This invoice has no open dispute.
x-error-catalog.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The feature exists in the contract but is not built yet.
